summary: Marten Transport filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its existing credit agreement. The Second Amendment, dated August 19, 2026, updates Term SOFR margins, increases the letter-of-credit sublimit from $35M to $50M, decreases the maximum aggregate principal from $105M to $100M, and extends the maturity to August 19, 2031. The facility remains an unsecured revolving credit line with U.S. Bank as agent. This is a routine credit facility modification, not a special situation, as it involves no change in control, capital structure event, or strategic action.
